findings.claim: With 'exclude boilerplate' and 'render as Markdown' both on, the Markdown pane still renders every chrome run on jpm-2024 (and csco-2016 page numbers) while the header says 'boilerplate hidden' — ADR-031 §b4's 'the S8 checkbox keeps its meaning in Markdown mode' is false and no eval case covers the omit path on real chrome.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/markdown.py:175 omits a block only when it lies WHOLLY inside a chrome span; src/sec10k/web/view.py:67 passes omit=spans. On jpm-2024 all 572 ADR-026 spans (running_head + page_number) sit INSIDE table blocks (e.g. span {start:218110,end:218146,kind:running_head} inside table block [218110,218149) 'JPMorgan Chase & Co./2024 Form 10-K\n\n49'), so 0 of 572 are omitted: to_markdown(text, blocks, tables, omit=spans) == to_markdown(text, blocks, tables) byte-for-byte and contains 286 'JPMorgan Chase & Co./2024 Form 10-K' running heads where strip_chrome leaves 0; build_view(extract_items(jpm, exclude_boilerplate=True, blocks=True)) item 15 display_text contains 8 of them in the first 40,000 span chars with boilerplate_excluded=True and index.html:804 printing 'boilerplate hidden ·' plus the meta line 'detected chrome is hidden from the text above'. csco-2016: 10 of 261 spans (page numbers inside tables) likewise. Only view.py::_demo (synthetic, chrome as a whole paragraph block) pins omit.
findings.repro: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.sec10k.extract import extract_items;from src.sec10k.markdown import to_markdown;from src.sec10k.boilerplate import strip_chrome;r=extract_items('evals/fixtures/jpm-2024/filing.htm',exclude_boilerplate=True,blocks=True);t=r['normalized_text'];s=r['boilerplate'];md=to_markdown(t,r['blocks'],r['tables'],omit=s);print(md.count('JPMorgan Chase & Co./2024 Form 10-K'), strip_chrome(t,s,0,len(t)).count('JPMorgan Chase & Co./2024 Form 10-K'), md==to_markdown(t,r['blocks'],r['tables']))"  -> 286 0 True
findings.acceptance: Either the Markdown view drops chrome that is inside a block (omit on overlap / strip chrome text from table cells and paragraphs as strip_chrome does) or the pane stops claiming 'boilerplate hidden' in Markdown mode when chrome remains; plus an adversarial case on jpm-2024 (exclude_boilerplate + blocks) that is red today and asserts the rendered Markdown carries 0 running heads (or the header label matches what is shown), and ADR-031 §b4 / the S9 row corrected accordingly.
